_comment: Accessibility budget: what each page must expose to UI Automation after round five. Written by tools/verify-a11y.ps1 -Update, which ratchets: each floor is max(previous, measured), so a re-pin on a degraded build cannot lower one. invokable = elements with an InvokePattern, distinctTab = distinct stops the Tab walk reached before its (Name, Type, rectangle) identity repeated - G21, round nine: the pair alone ended the walk at the second control sharing a name and read as a cycle. One floor was lowered once, by hand and on purpose: settings minFocusable 20 -> 19, because round nine removed the duplicate Edit node TextField used to publish (one focusable node was reported twice, and the second copy was never reachable) - a floor above what the tree can produce is unsatisfiable, which is not the same thing as a guard. The new coverage assertion is what now stops that class from coming back. Round eleven keys the pages from tools/page-set.ps1 and adds the three novel destinations the shell has carried since round ten; no desktop run has measured them yet, so their floors are seeded at 0 - a seeded zero bounds nothing, and the first measured -Update ratchets it up like every other floor (G15).
